subject: pathology
title: Crypt Abscesses, Pseudopolyps, Hirschsprung Disease, and Intestinal Tuberculosis

steps.tx: Crypt abscesses collect neutrophils inside colonic crypt lumens during active colitis of ulcerative colitis, infection, or ischaemia, marking activity rather than naming its cause. Activity is not aetiology: the **crypt abscess of active colitis**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Crypt abscesses shout active colitis, not ulcerative colitis specifically; infection makes them just as well.

steps.tx: Chronicity markers separate inflammatory bowel disease from self limited infection: distorted branching crypts, basal plasmacytosis, and Paneth cells beyond their ileal home declare longstanding colitis. That chronic signature is **histological chronicity in colonic biopsies**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Distorted crypts and basal plasma cells mean chronicity; acute infection keeps crypt architecture honest.

vis.alt: Crohn versus ulcerative colitis and Hirschsprung patterns
vis.caption: Inflammatory bowel disease patterns with Hirschsprung disease in the intestinal spectrum.

steps.tx: Pseudopolyps are surviving mucosal islands and granulation tags left standing between ulcerated seas in ulcerative colitis, inflammatory not neoplastic, yet surveillance still samples them with surrounding dysplasia vigilance. The inflammatory island is the **inflammatory pseudopolyp of ulcerative colitis**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Pseudopolyps are survivors, not precursors; the cancer risk lives in flat dysplasia around them.

steps.tx: Longstanding ulcerative colitis raises colorectal cancer risk by duration, extent, inflammation severity, primary sclerosing cholangitis, and family history, earning chromoendoscopy surveillance programmes. That risk schedule is **colitis associated cancer surveillance in ulcerative colitis**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Eight to ten years of extensive colitis starts cancer surveillance; sclerosing cholangitis starts it immediately.

steps.tx: Hirschsprung disease aganglionically paralyses distal colon from failed neural crest migration, presenting neonatal delayed meconium, distension, and explosive stool on examination, diagnosed by absent ganglion cells on suction biopsy. The aganglionic megacolon is **Hirschsprung disease of neural crest failure**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Delayed meconium plus explosive stool on examination means Hirschsprung disease until suction biopsy acquits it.

steps.tx: Intestinal tuberculosis favours ileocaecum with transverse ulcers, caseating granulomas, and strictures mimicking Crohn disease endoscopically, histologically, and radiologically in endemic regions. That great mimic is **ileocaecal tuberculosis versus Crohn disease**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Ileocaecal disease in endemic regions is tuberculosis versus Crohn until caseation, AFB, and cultures vote.

vis.caption: Tuberculosis dissemination patterns behind intestinal tuberculosis disease.

steps.tx: Transverse and circumferential ulcers favour tuberculosis, longitudinal serpiginous ulcers favour Crohn disease, while necrotic lymph nodes on imaging and ascites further tilt tuberculosis. Morphological voting performs **endoscopic separation of intestinal TB and Crohn disease**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: Transverse ulcers think tuberculosis, longitudinal think Crohn; nodes and ascites cast deciding votes.

steps.tx: Therapeutic tuberculosis trial traps await the impatient: steroids prescribed for presumed Crohn disease can disseminate tuberculosis fatally, so endemic uncertainty demands microbiological patience. That safety rule is **exclude intestinal tuberculosis before Crohn immunosuppression**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Never steroid endemic ileocaecal disease on a guess; tuberculosis disseminates under that mistake.
